breaking.change: A style pack is refused when it names a part of `chip`, `skeleton`, `spinner`, `cooldown`, `minimap`, `dialogue` or `actionbutton`, or `meter::part(trail)`, `meter::part(separator)` or `meter::part(label)`. No document element drew these parts, so the rules never dressed anything.
breaking.fix: Delete those rules. The components that replaced them are dressed through their own named parts: `[part="Cooldown.cell"]`, `[part="Minimap.frame"]`, `[part="SkeletonGroup.line"]`, `[part="Spinner.ring"]`, `[part="ActionButton.disc"]`, `[part="SpeechBubble.frame"]`.
